chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Every preacher is a Qiblah, meaning when the Imam addresses the people on the day of Friday, it is befitting for the people that they face towards him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on facing the Imam during the Friday sermon?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the jurisprudential concept of the Imam as a directional focal point (Qiblah) during the Friday sermon, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Imam's authority in communal worship. It underscores the ritual etiquette of facing the leader not merely as a physical orientation but as an act of obedience and unity, a practice deeply rooted in early Islamic tradition and elaborated upon by Shia jurists in their discussions on Salah.
